title: Fix DefineButton2 BUTTONCONDACTION encoding: actionOffset=0 and empty condActionBytes
description: src/__tests__/buttonactions.test.ts has 8 confirmed failures. The DefineButton2 encoder writes actionOffset=0 and empty condActionBytes for all button conditions (on(press), on(release), on(rollOver), on(rollOut)). The SWF spec requires each BUTTONCONDACTION record to include a correct actionOffset (byte offset to next record, or 0 for last) and the full ActionRecord bytecode stream. Fix: packages/swf/src/buttons.ts (or wherever DefineButton2 is encoded) — populate actionOffset and condActionBytes from the compiled condition action bytecode. Run pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run to verify all 8 tests pass.
